description: The row above a table: what it is called, how many rows it has, what narrows it, and what acts on it. Distinct from `<FilterBar>`, which is one of the things that goes inside it, and from `<PageHeader>`, which belongs to the screen rather than to this table. While a selection exists the toolbar is replaced by `batch`, which is the one arrangement that cannot mislead: an Export next to a "3 selected" bar has to say which three it means (Carbon batch action bar). Copy: the title names the collection and the count says how many are in it after filtering, not before.

props.name: title
props.description: What this table is called. Leave it out when the page heading above the table already says the same words.

props.name: as
props.description: Which heading level the title is. A level is a property of the DOCUMENT, not of the toolbar: under a section heading it is h3, directly under the page title it is h2. Default h3.

props.name: count
props.description: How many rows the table holds AFTER filtering. A count is orientation: without it a filtered table and a small table look identical.

props.name: children
props.description: The narrowing controls: a SearchInput, a FilterBar, a ColumnPicker.

props.name: actions
props.description: The table's own actions (create, export, import), at the trailing edge.

props.name: density
props.description: The row density this table is read at. Given with `onDensityChange`, the toolbar renders the switch. Density is a decision of the screen and of the reader, so remember the choice per collection rather than resetting it.

props.name: batch
props.description: Replaces the whole toolbar while rows are selected: pass `<BatchActions>`. One bar, two states, so the actions that apply to a selection never sit beside the ones that do not.
